en.headline: Teen sentenced to eight years for acid attack on Singaporean tourist
en.dek: High Court Judge Andrew Chan jailed the 19-year-old for throwing sulphuric acid at a 36-year-old woman in Wan Chai last June, causing burns over more than 10 per cent of her body.
body: A 19-year-old man was sentenced to eight years in prison on Thursday for throwing sulphuric acid at a Singaporean tourist in Wan Chai last year.

The defendant, who was 17 at the time of the offence, admitted one count of sprinkling corrosive liquid with intent to cause grievous bodily harm. The attack took place on 9 June 2025 outside The Hennessy on Hennessy Road, where the 36-year-old woman was getting into a car after meeting her sister.

She suffered chemical burns covering more than 10 per cent of her body, including second-degree burns to her legs, and later developed post-traumatic stress requiring medication. The defendant had scouted the location in advance and was paid HK$10,000 for the act. He turned himself in two days later.

Justice Andrew Chan Hing-wai took a starting point of 12 years and reduced the term for the guilty plea. He said the injuries were likely to have a lifelong impact and, based on judicial experience, believed the incident was connected to triad activity, although the defendant denied membership.

zh.headline: 19歲男子向新加坡女子淋腐液 判囚8年
zh.dek: 高等法院法官陳慶偉周四判處19歲男子監禁8年，他去年6月在灣仔向一名36歲新加坡女子淋潑硫酸，造成全身逾一成皮膚灼傷。
body: 一名19歲男子周四被高等法院判處監禁8年，罪名是去年在灣仔向一名新加坡籍女子淋潑腐蝕性液體。
被告案發時17歲，承認一項意圖造成身體嚴重傷害而淋潑腐蝕性液體罪。事發於2025年6月9日，灣仔軒尼詩道The Hennessy大廈對出，36歲女事主與胞姊會面後登上私家車時遭襲。
女事主全身逾一成皮膚化學灼傷，雙腿達二級燒傷，其後出現創傷後遺症需藥物治療。被告事前曾到現場踩點，並收取1萬元報酬行事，事後兩日到警署自首。
法官陳慶偉以12年作為量刑起點，因認罪減至8年。他指事主創傷恐遺留一世，並憑司法經驗相信事件與黑社會有關，儘管被告否認是成員。
